The official chapter trailer sets the update for September 6 at 7:00 p.m
PDT — September 7 at 02:00 UTC — ahead of the game’s October shutdown. Fund your pullsPC games for less

Enter your UID, pick any server — no regional account needed.Affiliate linkSee today's pricesInstant delivery The official Google Play listing now describes the third-anniversary event as live
For returning players, the FF7 Ever Crisis final anniversary leaves roughly a month to catch up before service ends. The original FFVII story reaches Chapter 13 Square Enix’s official Final Fantasy video page lists The Planet’s End as Chapter 13
The trailer below previews the concluding chapter and contains late-game story footage. In his producer’s letter, Shoichi Ichikawa outlined an anniversary send-off with new weapons, gear and seasonal quests, plus customization options for selected existing weapons
Those additions accompany the story finale in the closing content plan. The same letter set out a three-part adaptation of Before Crisis for July and August, alongside returning events intended to help players who had stepped away catch up. When does Ever Crisis shut down? The end of service notice gives the deadline as October 6, 2026, at 11:00 p.m
PDT, equivalent to October 7 at 06:00 UTC
The shutdown covers both the Japanese and global versions. Sales of Red Crystals ended on July 7 at 7:00 p.m
Crystals already held can still be used until service ends, and the team says in-game events will continue to be released and updated until then. Developed by Applibot and published by Square Enix, Ever Crisis launched on iOS and Android on September 7, 2023, followed by Steam on December 6
The FF7 Ever Crisis final anniversary closes out that three-year run with the original story’s conclusion. The new iOS and Android MMORPG from Playwith Korea continues the Seal Online series with five classes, party activities, pets and two collectible progression systems. Fund your pullsPC games for less
Cashback on every top-up.Genesis Crystals, Oneiric Shards, Astrites and thousands of Steam keys in one store
Enter your UID, pick any server — no regional account needed.Affiliate linkSee today's pricesInstant delivery The publisher introduced the name and brand identity in August before opening the registration campaign
The official site now accepts both mobile-number registration and store pre-registration, with rewards attached to individual registration, community milestones and friend invitations. Seal M2 keeps the series’ colorful style and includes collectible pets alongside character progression. Seal M2 pre-registration rewards The base registration package includes 50 Ooparts summon tickets and 50 Costume summon tickets
Players who also complete store pre-registration can receive Alexandra, a horse mount shown on the campaign page. Playwith Korea has also set five community targets: 100,000 registrations: 10 fast-travel tickets.300,000 registrations: five revival items.500,000 registrations: 10 Costume summon tickets.800,000 registrations: 10 Ooparts summon tickets.1 million registrations: the Succession Gigantes mount. The friend-invitation event provides additional tickets according to the number of successful invitations, reaching a combined maximum of 30 Ooparts summon tickets and 30 Costume summon tickets
The official page says Korean pre-registration will remain available until launch. Classes, costumes and Ooparts Seal M2 currently presents five playable classes: Knight, Archer, Mage, Priest and Jester
The official class pages outline distinct combat roles, ranging from close-range defense to ranged damage, magic and party support. Costumes change a character’s appearance and form one of the game’s collectible upgrade tracks
Ooparts are a separate progression system, and the official overview says both can be strengthened through synthesis and transcendence
The site also discloses that the game includes probability-based items. The official site presents costumes as both visual customization and a collectible progression system. Party dungeons and other multiplayer content The feature overview lists party dungeons, field bosses, Sage’s Tower and a challenge battlefield
Pets accompany characters in combat, while group activities are designed around the class lineup and its different offensive, defensive and support roles. The official trailer offers the clearest look so far at the game’s environments, character models and combat presentation: Korean release status The confirmed launch target is Q4 2026 in South Korea
The registration page and current campaign terms are Korean-language, and neither the website nor Playwith Korea’s announcement confirms an international version. That means the reward campaign should be treated as regional until the publisher says otherwise
A precise Korean launch date has not yet been announced.
